mapper.select: SELECT invoice_id,content,sha256,size_bytes,uploaded_by,uploaded_at,received_at FROM invoice_document WHERE invoice_id=#{invoiceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT d.invoice_id,d.sha256,d.size_bytes,d.uploaded_at,d.received_at FROM invoice_document d JOIN invoice_request r ON r.id=d.invoice_id WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY d.invoice_id
mapper.update: UPDATE invoice_document SET received_at=COALESCE(received_at,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE invoice_id=#{invoiceId} AND sha256=#{sha256}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM invoice_document WHERE invoice_id IN (SELECT id FROM invoice_request WHERE user_id=#{userId})
